name: SharePoint
description: 在 CoTree 中搜索 SharePoint 站点、读取页面与文件、整理责任人与状态，并在授权范围创建或更新列表项。

skills.name: cotree.sharepoint.connect
skills.description: 配置独立 SharePoint Graph OAuth 并核对租户和范围。

skills.name: cotree.sharepoint.discover
skills.description: 搜索 SharePoint 站点并定位文档库与列表。

skills.name: cotree.sharepoint.pages
skills.description: 读取 SharePoint 现代站点页面与实际内容。

skills.name: cotree.sharepoint.files
skills.description: 定位并下载授权的 SharePoint 文件进行本地分析。

skills.name: cotree.sharepoint.lists
skills.description: 读取 SharePoint 列定义与列表项并提取实际状态。

skills.name: cotree.sharepoint.update
skills.description: 创建或更新已授权 SharePoint 列表项并读回。

skills.name: cotree.sharepoint.summarize
skills.description: 汇总 SharePoint 页面、文档和列表的责任人与状态。
